annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2015 of 4 September 2026 amending and repealing Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2015 of 4 September 2026 amending and repealing Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision amending the list of harmonised machinery standards conferring presumption of conformity under Directive 2006/42/EC, adding many standards including EN ISO 10218-1/-2:2025 for industrial robots and EN ISO 18497 for autonomous agricultural machinery, and repealing Decision 2023/1586 from 20 January 2027 when the Machinery Regulation applies.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds references of new and revised harmonised machinery standards to Annex I of Decision (EU) 2023/1586
Includes EN ISO 10218-1:2025 and -2:2025 on industrial robot safety and robot cells
Includes EN ISO 18497 parts 1-4 on safety of semi-autonomous and autonomous agricultural machinery
Decision 2023/1586 repealed with effect from 20 January 2027 as Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 replaces the Machinery Directive
Enters into force on publication, conferring presumption of conformity immediately
